quest.title: Studies in Light and Shadow: A Fontaine of Enchantment
quest.description: In Fontaine's countryside, a man named Bresson seems to have encountered some trouble...
quest.rewards_formatted: Bresson's Special Kamera x1, Mora x10000, Adventurer's Experience x4

talks.objective: Talk to the person by the water

dialogues.speaker: Bresson
dialogues.text: Have faith in yourself, Bresson... Have faith. All the tools have been prepared...

dialogues.speaker: Bresson
dialogues.text: You just need to... go underwater. Yes, underwater... Go there and prove that these tools are reliable, and your work will be complete!

dialogues.speaker: Bresson
dialogues.text: Eh? Where did you come from? I didn't hear you coming at all!

dialogues.speaker: Bresson
dialogues.text: I almost fell into the water, you know — if I hadn't regained my balance, the future of photography in Fontaine would have gone down the... water!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, don't you know how to swim?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: And you're from Fontaine, aren't you?

response.speaker: Bresson
response.text: Who... Who said that people from Fontaine must know how to swim? Not every person from Liyue can cook, and not every Mondstadter's a poet!

response.speaker: Bresson
response.text: Whatever. I went through all this effort to get diving apparatus. Today, I must go underwater to take some pictures...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, so that's what going on...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Is there something special about this Kamera?

response.speaker: Bresson
response.text: Special? I, Bresson Cartier, modified the Kamera personally. This is why it's "special."

response.speaker: Bresson
response.text: My modification techniques are strict and ingenious, and I only use the very finest materials.

response.speaker: Bresson
response.text: The lens is countless times better than those you'll find on any other Kameras. Indeed, there will be no loss in image quality even if you go underwater!

response.speaker: Bresson
response.text: But those people in the Kamera Club... They don't care about my new techniques at all. They claim that the key to photography lies in the skill of the photographers themselves, and not their tools...

response.speaker: Bresson
response.text: But just you wait, I say. I will take some brilliant pictures, and shut those ignoramuses right up!

response.speaker: Bresson
response.text: Phew... Come on, Bresson. Believe in yourself... Believe... the water is warm and comfy, and it's definitely not full of man-eating fish...

response.speaker: Bresson
response.text: I... I... Ugh, will this divesuit really work? Will it suddenly explode underwater!?

response.speaker: Bresson
response.text: After which I shall be dragged into the watery depths, never to be seen again... I... Oh, Archons...

choices.text: If you really can't do it, I can help you...

response.speaker: Bresson
response.text: Really? Would you do this? Would you aid me? A most generous soul, you are! Indeed, my savior!

choices.text: Well, I expect to be paid, regardless.

response.speaker: Bresson
response.text: Well, of course I won't be making you do this for free. Your recompense will be rich, trust me!

response.speaker: Bresson
response.text: Ah yes, right. Allow me to mark some good underwater scenery on your map...

response.speaker: Bresson
response.text: There are also some on land... Uh... That should be around here... This is brand-new equipment, after all. It wouldn't hurt to test them out at a few more spots.

response.speaker: Bresson
response.text: Alright, this will do. I leave Fontaine's technical photographic future and my vision for Kamera tools in your capable hands.

response.speaker: Bresson
response.text: I shall... uh, wait for you on the shore.

choices.text: I'll need remuneration according to Guild rules.
Why don't I take some photos underwater for you?
I didn't expect you to react that intensely...

talks.objective: Talk to the person by the water
